# dji.dz0ny.dev

> A personal archive of 360° aerial panoramas, shot on a DJI drone and viewable as full spheres in the browser.

## Overview

Public gallery of equirectangular drone panoramas. Every frame can be dragged, pinched, and looked around in
directly on a phone; the untouched original is one tap away. Uploads are private — restricted to the site owner
via Cloudflare Access — but viewing is open to everyone.

## Key Pages

- [Gallery](/) — every panorama, newest first
- [Viewer](/p/<id>/) — a single panorama full-screen, with its own link preview

## API

- `GET /~/api/photos` — public JSON listing of every panorama and its metadata
- `GET /~/img/{thumb|preview|original}/<id>` — the image bytes

## Contact

- Website: https://dji.dz0ny.dev
